documentInfo.description: VALID: Combined taxonomy D importing both taxonomy B (ext1) and taxonomy C (ext2), each of which independently import and extend base taxonomy A. The DAG duplicate-import rule ensures A is processed only once (encountered via B→A and C→A). D's resolved exp:ProductDomain contains all three members in import order: exp:ProductA (from A), exp2:ProductB (from B's extension), exp3:ProductC (from C's extension). This demonstrates the diamond extendTargetName pattern — multiple independent taxonomies extending the same base domain QName, merged in the combining taxonomy.
